column3: a. 有镇静作用的;n. 镇静剂
column5: Doctors warned that mixing any depressant with alcohol slows breathing dangerously.
column6: 医生警告,任何抑制剂与酒精同服都会严重抑制呼吸。

column3: a. 深奥的, 难解的, 隐藏的
column5: His recondite lectures on Byzantine tax law attracted only four students.
column6: 他关于拜占庭税法的深奥课程只吸引来四个学生。

column3: a. 孩子气的, 天真的, 未成熟的;儿童的, 幼稚的
column5: The debate sank into puerile insults within its first ten minutes.
column6: 辩论开始不到十分钟就沦为幼稚的人身攻击。

column3: n. 假笑, 傻笑, 痴笑;vi. 假笑, 傻笑, 痴笑
column5: The intern could only simper when the director praised his modest work.
column6: 主管称赞他的工作时,实习生只会假笑。

column3: a. 不忠贞的, 背信的, 有异心的
column5: The perfidious advisor sold the general's battle plans to the opposing army.
column6: 背信弃义的谋士把将军的作战计划卖给了敌军。

column3: a. 能抓的, 善于领会的, 贪得无厌的;抓握的, 捕捉的
column5: The monkey's prehensile tail grips branches as firmly as a fifth hand.
column6: 猴子能缠握的尾巴像第五只手一样抓紧树枝。

column3: a. 两手俱利的, 搞两面派的;两手同利的
column5: The ambidextrous pitcher baffled hitters by switching arms between batters.
column6: 能左右开弓的投手在击球手之间换手投球,令人难以捉摸。

column3: n. 消灭, 根除, 毁灭;摘除
column5: The campaign aimed at the complete extirpation of the invasive water weed.
column6: 该行动旨在彻底铲除入侵性的水生杂草。

column3: n. 预感
column5: A vague presentiment of trouble kept the captain awake before the storm.
column6: 对灾祸模糊的预感让船长在风暴前夜彻夜难眠。

column3: a. 暂时的, 非永久的
column5: Sand mandalas are deliberately impermanent, swept away upon their completion.
column6: 沙坛城刻意不为久存,一完成便被扫掉。

column3: n. 徒步旅行, 旅程, 人生历程, 漫谈, 泛论
column5: The book records the author's peregrination along ancient pilgrim roads to Santiago.
column6: 本书记录了作者沿着古道前往圣地亚哥的漫长漫游。

column3: v. (使)落叶
column5: An early frost can defoliate the valley's vineyards almost overnight.
column6: 一场早霜几乎一夜之间就能让山谷的葡萄园落叶。

column3: n. 慷慨激昂的演说, 雄辩, 慷慨激昂的演说词
column5: The festival opened with a student's declamation of the poet's famous ode.
column6: 艺术节以学生朗诵诗人的著名颂歌拉开帷幕。

column3: n. 戏法, 骗术, 诡辩
column5: The accountant's legerdemain with figures hid the losses for three fiscal years.
column6: 会计在数字上的巧妙花招把亏损隐瞒了三个财年。

column3: n. 粗暴, 严酷, 粗糙
column5: The judge responded with unusual asperity to the lawyer's third delay request.
column6: 面对律师第三次延期请求,法官以罕见的严厉口吻回应。

column3: n. 初学者, 生手, 新手
column5: As a tyro sailor, he volunteered only for the simplest deck duties.
column6: 作为新手水手,他只主动承担最简单的甲板工作。

column3: a. 舌的, 舌音的, 语言的;n. 舌音
column5: The clinic offers lingual braces fitted behind the teeth for discreet straightening.
column6: 该诊所提供装在牙齿内侧的隐形牙箍矫治。

column3: n. 近地点
column5: The moon appears largest tonight because perigee coincides with the full phase.
column6: 今晚月亮看起来最大,因为近地点恰逢满月。

column3: n. 天芥菜属植物, 淡紫色;向阳植物; 鸡血石
column5: Bees crowded around the purple heliotrope that scented the cottage garden.
column6: 蜜蜂围着散发香气的紫色天芥菜聚满了村舍花园。

column3: n. 慷慨, 宽宏大量, 心胸宽大, 胸怀广阔, 公正, 丰富, 宽阔, 丰满
column5: The university's liberality toward visiting scholars made its libraries famous worldwide.
column6: 这所大学对访问学者的慷慨使其图书馆闻名世界。

column3: a. 粗糙的, 多痂的, 难解决的, 猥亵的
column5: The tabloid's scabrous gossip about the actress finally drew a formal lawsuit.
column6: 小报对女演员的下流八卦最终招来正式诉讼。

column3: vt. 发誓抛弃, 发誓否定;vi. 发伪誓, 作伪证
column5: After the scandal, the minister swore he would forswear politics forever.
column6: 丑闻之后,部长发誓永远放弃政治。

column3: vt. 补偿, 赎;vi. 抵偿, 赎罪
column5: He spent a decade trying to expiate a single careless remark.
column6: 他用了十年试图弥补一句轻率的失言。

column3: n. 泼妇, 悍妇
column5: Neighbors whispered that the old widow was a virago who terrorized delivery men.
column6: 邻居们私下说那老寡妇是个吓跑送货员的悍妇。

column3: a. 未受指导的, 无姓名和地址的
column5: His undirected anger after the layoff worried his closest friends.
column6: 裁员后他无处发泄的怒气让挚友担忧。

column3: a. 大洪水前的, 陈旧的, 过时的;n. 大洪水以前的人, 老迈的人
column5: The office still uses an antediluvian fax machine that squeals at every page.
column6: 办公室还在用每传一页就尖叫的老古董传真机。

column3: n. 收益, 钱财
column5: He claimed to despise lucre, yet checked his portfolio every lunchtime.
column6: 他嘴上鄙视钱财,午休时却盯着投资账户不放。

column3: a. 华丽而庸俗的, 俗气的, 娼妓的
column5: The lobby's meretricious glitter of gold and marble concealed shoddy construction.
column6: 大堂金玉其外的浮华掩盖了拙劣的施工质量。

column3: a. 不隐瞒的, 坦白的
column5: The committee offered its unreserved apology for the misleading safety report.
column6: 委员会为误导性的安全报告作出毫无保留的道歉。

column3: a. 不必要的, 怠惰的, 没有用的, 多余的
column5: The second inspection proved otiose, since the first had cleared everything.
column6: 第二次检查纯属多余,因为第一次已全部放行。
